cards.ex: He admitted he was guilty, but ten years in prison still seemed like rough justice.
cards.exUz: U aybdorligini tan oldi, lekin o'n yil qamoq jazosi baribir qattiq adolatdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatning qattiq va rasmiy bo'lmagan shakli, ba'zan adolatli bo'lmagan natijaga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The company stacked the deck by hiring consultants they knew would give a favorable report.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zlariga ma'qul hisobot beradigan maslahatchilarni yollash orqali o'yinni soxtalashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir noqonuniy yoki adolatsiz yo'l bilan bir tomonga foydali qilish.

cards.ex: The investigation was conducted strictly by the book, so there's no room for complaint.
cards.exUz: Tergov qat'iy qoidalarga muvofiq o'tkazildi, shuning uchun shikoyatga o'rin yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga va protseduralarga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: He got fired for stealing; it serves him right.
cards.exUz: U o'g'irlik uchun ishdan bo'shatildi; haqli jazosini oldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishi yomon ish qilgani uchun qandaydir yomonlikka duch kelganida aytiladi.

cards.ex: He spent years planning how to even the score with the people who betrayed him.
cards.exUz: U xiyonat qilgan odamlardan qasos olish uchun qanday hisobni tenglashni rejalashtirishga yillar sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi xato yoki adolatsizlik uchun qasos olish.

cards.ex: The new regulations are designed to level the playing field for small businesses.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar kichik biznes uchun sharoitlarni tenglashtirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Raqobat uchun adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar yaratish.

cards.ex: I try not to take sides when my kids are arguing; it's better to stay neutral.
cards.exUz: Bolalarim bahslashayotganda men hech qachon tomonni olmaslikka harakat qilaman; betaraf bo'lish yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Bahs yoki mojaroda kimningdir tomonini qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: The auditor's report confirmed that the company's finances were above suspicion.
cards.exUz: Auditorlik hisoboti kompaniyaning moliyasi gumondan yuqori ekanligini tasdiqladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha tug'dirmaydigan, benuqson.

cards.ex: He got a slap on the wrist for his serious ethical violations; it was a joke.
cards.exUz: U jiddiy axloqiy buzilishlari uchun engil jazo oldi; bu hazil edi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik xato uchun juda yumshoq jazo.

cards.ex: We believe they are negotiating in good faith, even though progress is slow.
cards.exUz: Biz ularning halol niyatda muzokara olib borayotganiga ishonamiz, garchi taraqqiyot sekin bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Halol va samimiy niyat bilan.

cards.ex: New evidence emerged that vindicated him of the crime he was accused of.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillar paydo bo'lib, uni ayblangan jinoyatdan oqladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir aybsizligini isbotlash, xato fikrdan xalos qilish.

cards.ex: I'll give him the benefit of the doubt this time, but I'm watching him closely.
cards.exUz: Men unga bu safar shubhani bekor qilaman, lekin uni diqqat bilan kuzatib boraman.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining rost gapirayotganiga ishonishga qaror qilish, dalillar to'liq bo'lmasa ham.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to a fair trial, regardless of the severity of the crime.
cards.exUz: Har bir kishi jinoyatning og'irligidan qat'i nazar, adolatli sudga haqlidir.
cards.uzDef: Qonun bo'yicha adolatli va xolis sud.

cards.ex: Despite the corruption, we still hope that justice prevails in the end.
cards.exUz: Korruptsiyaga qaramay, biz oxir-oqibatda adolat g'alaba qozonishiga umid qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Adolat oxir-oqibatda yomonlik ustidan g'alaba qozonadi.

cards.ex: A good judge must be even-handed and impartial in all cases.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi sudya barcha hollarda xolis va betaraf bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha tomonlarga adolatli va teng munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: In the eyes of the law, everyone is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
cards.exUz: Qonun nuqtai nazaridan, har bir kishi aybdorligi isbotlanmaguncha begunoh deb hisoblanadi.
cards.term: in the eyes of the law
cards.uzDef: Qonunning nuqtai nazariga ko'ra, qonuniy jihatdan.

cards.ex: He agreed to take the fall for his friend to protect him from prison.
cards.exUz: U do'stini qamoqdan himoya qilish uchun uning xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olishga rozi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaning xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: The company's decision to fire him seemed completely arbitrary and unfair.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning uni ishdan bo'shatish qarori butunlay asossiz va adolatsizdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday asosli sababsiz qabul qilingan qaror.

cards.ex: The minister's conduct should be above reproach to maintain public trust.
cards.exUz: Vazirning xulq-atvori jamoatchilik ishonchini saqlab qolish uchun tanqidga loyiq bo'lmasligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xulq-atvori yoki harakatlari tanqidga loyiq emas.

cards.ex: You can't accuse others of corruption if you don't have clean hands yourself.
cards.exUz: Agar o'zingizning qo'llaringiz toza bo'lmasa, boshqalarni korruptsiyada ayblay olmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir adolatli va halol bo'lsa.

cards.ex: It was poetic justice when the bully was finally stood up to.
cards.exUz: Bezori nihoyat qarshilik ko'rsatilganda bu poetik adolat edi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odamning oxir-oqibatda qilgan ishlariga munosib jazo olishi.

cards.ex: He knew he'd have to face the music for lying to the police.
cards.exUz: U politsiyaga yolg'on gapirgani uchun javobgarlikka tortilishini bilardi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlar uchun oqibatlarga duch kelish.

cards.ex: It's outrageous that he got off scot-free after causing so much damage.
cards.exUz: U juda ko'p zarar yetkazganidan keyin jazosiz qolgani sharmandalik.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday jazo olmasdan, yomon ishdan qutulish.

cards.ex: The prosecutor vowed to show no mercy to those involved in the drug trafficking ring.
cards.exUz: Prokuror giyohvand moddalar savdosi bilan shug'ullanuvchilarga rahm qilmaslikka va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga rahm-shafqat ko'rsatmaslik, qattiq munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to ensure that all students are on an equal footing when they start university.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha talabalarning universitetni boshlashda teng sharoitda bo'lishini ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Teng imkoniyatlar va huquqlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The judge's biased ruling was a travesty of justice and undermined public trust.
cards.exUz: Sudyaning adolatsiz hukmi adolatning buzilishi bo'lib, jamoatchilik ishonchini yo'qqa chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatning buzilishi yoki adolatning jiddiy xatosi.

cards.ex: No one should be above the law, regardless of their position or power.
cards.exUz: Hech kim o'z lavozimi yoki kuchidan qat'i nazar, qonundan yuqori bo'lmasligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qonun unga tegishli emas deb hisoblash.

cards.ex: The boss laid down the law about punctuality, and everyone had to comply.
cards.exUz: Boshliq o'z vaqtida bo'lish haqida qonunni belgilab qo'ydi va hamma unga rioya qilishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni qat'iy tarzda belgilash va ularga rioya qilinishini talab qilish.

cards.ex: In some countries, suspected criminals are subjected to summary justice without a fair trial.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi mamlakatlarda gumonlanuvchi jinoyatchilar adolatli sudda qatnashmasdan tezkor adolatga tortiladi.
cards.uzDef: Sud jarayonisiz tez va rasmiy bo'lmagan adolat.

cards.ex: It's important to hold the line on ethical principles, even when it's difficult.
cards.exUz: Qiyin bo'lsa ham, axloqiy tamoyillarda qat'iy turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri deb bilgan narsada qat'iy turish.
